`enum MouseButton`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.input.mouse` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [MouseButton.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/input/mouse/MouseButton.java)

A mouse button, as the mouse events of nodes and UIs report it.

## Description

Every mouse event holds the button that sent it: [`NodeMouseEvent.getButton`](/reference/events/nodemouseevent/#NodeMouseEvent-method-getButton) on a node, [`UIMouseEvent.getButton`](/reference/events/uimouseevent/#UIMouseEvent-method-getButton) on a UI.
Test it with the `isX()` predicates, for example to open a context menu on a right press only.

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`LEFT`](#MouseButton-value-LEFT) | The primary button, number `0`. |
| [`RIGHT`](#MouseButton-value-RIGHT) | The secondary button, number `1`. |
| [`MIDDLE`](#MouseButton-value-MIDDLE) | The wheel button, number `2`. |
| [`BACK`](#MouseButton-value-BACK) | The side button that a browser maps to "back", number `3`. |
| [`FORWARD`](#MouseButton-value-FORWARD) | The side button that a browser maps to "forward", number `4`. |
| [`OTHER`](#MouseButton-value-OTHER) | Any button beyond the first five; JOID does not tell them apart. |

## Creation details

<a id="MouseButton-factory-of"></a>

### of

`MouseButton of(int button)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Returns the button of a button number of the window library: `0` left, `1` right, `2` middle, `3` back, `4` forward.
Any other number gives [`MouseButton.OTHER`](/reference/input/mousebutton/#MouseButton-value-OTHER).

<a id="MouseButton-method-getButton"></a>

### getButton

`int getButton()` 

Returns the button number of this button, the inverse of `of(int)`.
[`MouseButton.OTHER`](/reference/input/mousebutton/#MouseButton-value-OTHER) returns `-1`, because it stands for every other number.
